text:
maria: Midday pulse — quick snapshot before lunch. Queue at 48 tickets (↑6 since morning). Breakdown: P1:2, P2:9, P3:28, P4/ops:9. Two customer-facing P1s open (both email ingestion failures).

jonathan: I'm on P1 #TKT-8912 (enterprise account) — investigating SMTP relay errors, looks like bounces from their provider. Have a debug log if anyone wants it.

maria: thx @jonathan. Can you post the last 20 lines of the relay logs here? if it's sensitive, paste in #secure-logs.

jonathan: pasted a redacted snippet: ```
2026-03-17T15:02:12Z ERROR smtp: relay refused RCPT TO <...> 554 5.7.1
2026-03-17T15:02:13Z WARN  retry in 30s
```

priya: For the other P1 (#TKT-8925) — it's our email connector in eu-west-1. We've seen intermittent 502s from the connector service since 02:30 UTC. Raised a regional incident and pinned mitigation: routing fallback to connector-v2.

status-bot: Incident created: INC-452 (email-connector-eu-west1) — assigned to priya, severity P1. Link: https://internal/redwood/incidents/INC-452

alex: Current macros updated with a temporary customer-facing message for email failures. Copy below — please review: 

```
Hello — we're currently investigating delivery issues affecting email ingestion. If you're seeing failures, please: 1) confirm SMTP credentials 2) check provider bounces 3) reply with a sample message id. We're working on a fix and will update within 60 minutes.
```

maria: Looks good. Add a line about workaround: "If immediate delivery is required, enable webhook fallback in integration settings."

priya: Added. Macro name `email_connector_outage_v1` updated. Patch: `PATCH /macros/email_connector_outage_v1` (deployed).

nora: Queue note — three long-running P3s are waiting on engineering (label: needs-eng). @eng-sre FYI.

maria: Action items:
- jonathan continue debugging SMTP for #TKT-8912 and escalate if relay provider confirms blocks.
- priya keep INC-452 updates hourly and post ETA.
- alex please push the macro to the shared library and mark it for CS->SOC use.
- nora prioritize the needs-eng list and create follow-ups in PRC.

jonathan: quick ask — can someone review my CR for the log-redaction change? it's blocking my ability to share full logs. PR: https://git.redwood/sr/log-redact (small patch).

priya: I'll take the CR after this incident update.

maria: OK — check back here at 16:00 UTC for an end-of-day summary. If anything escalates before then, ping @maria-direct or drop a thread here. :thumbsup:

status-bot: Note: nightly macro sync job scheduled at 02:00 UTC — next run will include `email_connector_outage_v1`.

alex: FYI we have 4 access requests pending for customer logs; handled those this morning (cleared 2, 2 awaiting approvals).

maria: Thanks team — appreciate moving quickly.

(thumbsup reaction from priya, checkmark from jonathan)
